name: artist-caption-bedroom
description: Candid front-facing selfie with text caption overlay — the kind of post Gen Z artists make on TikTok/IG

camera.angle: held slightly below face, looking down at lens
camera.quality: phone camera in low light, slight noise and grain, not DSLR sharp
camera.focus: face in focus, background slightly soft but not artificially blurred

environment.feel: real, uncontrolled, wherever they happen to be
environment.lighting: soft, dim purple glow from a desk lamp or LED strip — barely illuminating the room, heavy shadows, most of the frame is dark, only the face catches light
environment.backgrounds: real lived-in bedroom — unmade bed, plain walls, ceiling vents, clutter, nothing curated or staged
environment.avoid: clean renders, perfect symmetry, stock-photo rooms, AI-looking environments, smooth surfaces, studio backdrops

subject.expression: deadpan, slightly bored, vulnerable, not smiling for the camera
subject.pose: casual — hand in hair, hood up, slouched, not posed or performative
subject.clothing: oversized hoodie, sweater, or dark casual top
subject.framing: head and shoulders, close crop, face takes up most of the frame

realism.priority: the image must look like a real phone photo, not AI-generated
realism.texture: grainy, slightly noisy, imperfect skin texture visible
realism.imperfections: messy hair, wrinkled fabric, uneven lighting, random objects in background
realism.avoid: smooth skin, perfect hair, symmetrical composition, clean backgrounds, hyper-sharp detail, uncanny valley
